_readme: Rough per-unit cost by category/subcategory (USD), used only to estimate PO Order Value (PO Quantity x unit cost) for the AQL recommendation's PO Size band. Not a pricing/финance source of truth - just enough to bucket into the right inspection rigor. Editable via Settings. A real per-order factory price from Order Management (stored in RMB) is preferred over this table when one exists for the SKU, converted to USD via rmbToUsdRate - this table is the fallback for SKUs without PO data yet.
